study_type_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic profile of all four protein/DOX and free DOX were obtained through tail vein injection of healthy Sprague Dawley rats.
Cytotoxicity assay compared IC50 values of drug carried by four HFn-based proteins.

in_vivo_species.quote: Specific-pathogen free Sprague Dawley rats (male, 230-250 g, SPF Biotechnology Co., Ltd. Beijing, China)

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: female BALB/c, 8 weeks, 4T1 tumour-bearing (imaging and efficacy only)
in_vivo_species.quote: 1 x 106 4T1 cells in 100 μL of PBS were injected into right armpit of 8-week old female BALB/c mice

in_vitro_detail: Cellular uptake, intracellular distribution and cytotoxicity (IC50) in 4T1 cells.

agents.name: HFn/DOX
agents.sequence_source: Not printed as a one-letter string in the body, which describes the constructs (human ferritin heavy chain with C-terminal PAS peptide, GFLG or PLGLAG cleavable linker and RGDK). Sequence is PEPlife2's and is consistent with that description.
agents.group_n_quote: Half-life of each protein/DOX in Sprague Dawley rats (n = 3).
agents.dose_route_quote: administrated with PBS, free DOX and protein/DOX (3.0 mg kg-1 DOX equivalent) separately via intravenous injection at tail vein
agents.half_life_matrix: rat serum - DOXORUBICIN fluorescence, not protein concentration
agents.cmax: approximately 35 μg/mL at 10 min for the functionalised HFns; 21.6 μg/mL for HFn/DOX; 15 μg/mL for free DOX
agents.pk_quote: PAS peptide in HFn-PAS/DOX has increased half-life almost 4.9 times (14.96 h) compared with HFn/DOX.

bioanalytical_method: Doxorubicin fluorescence in serum (ex 480 nm, em 580 nm) on a SpectraMax i3x plate reader against a DOX-in-rat-serum standard curve; single-compartment fit in Drug Analysis System 2.0
bioanalytical_quote: the DOX contents were determined using SpectraMax i3x microplate reader ... Excitation wavelength was set at 480 nm and emission at 580 nm
notes: All four PEPlife2 values verified exactly against Table 3: 3.07 ± 0.06, 14.96 ± 0.29, 17.61 ± 0.39 and 18.93 ± 0.61 h. THE MEASURED ANALYTE IS DOXORUBICIN, by its own fluorescence, not the ferritin protein - no protein assay is performed. These records are nonetheless retained, unlike the fasudil records of 31194563, because here the protein IS the carrier rather than a surface ligand, all four rows share the same dose and route, and the label tracks the protein engineering monotonically (3.07 h for bare HFn, 14.96 h once PAS is fused, 17.61 and 18.93 h with RGDK added). Free DOX clears with a 0.42 h half-life, so the signal is dominated by the carrier. The caveat that remains is that these are DOX-release-and-clearance half-lives, an upper-bounded proxy for the protein's own circulation time, not a direct measurement of it. Sequences are PEPlife2's concatenations including hyphen-delimited linkers; the hyphens are stripped by the training-set sequence cleaner.
